name: notion-research-documentation
tagline_zh: 不用再开十个标签页手动拼凑资料。它跨页面搜索、自动归纳，生成带出处的新页面，让调研从半天缩到十分钟。
tagline_en: Stop manually stitching tabs. It searches across your workspace, synthesizes, and saves a structured report with.
desc_en: Searches across your Notion workspace, synthesizes findings from multiple pages, and creates comprehensive research documentation saved as new Notion pages. Turns scattered information into structured reports with proper citations and actionable insights.
why_zh: 不是简单搜索，而是理解上下文后跨页综合，输出结构化报告并保留引用，让结论可追溯。
why_en: Goes beyond search: understands context, cross-page synthesis, outputs structured docs with traceable sources.
limit_zh: 仅限 Notion 工作区内的内容，需要已登录的 Notion 账号和网络连接；不处理图片、PDF 或外部网页。
limit_en: Only Notion workspace content; requires logged-in Notion account & internet. No images, PDFs, or external web pages.
title_en: Search all Notion, synthesize, and save cited reports as.
